notes: AbSci de novo HER2 binder release at revision cd2bd4b6932b5301d435555dc22084d407e4b92b. Per-file retrieval URLs are pinned in the untracked retrieval record data/raw/her2_functional_20260918/source_manifest.json; each is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AbSciBio/unlocking-de-novo-antibody-design/cd2bd4b6932b5301d435555dc22084d407e4b92b/<upstream_path>. ROLE IN THIS STUDY: diagnostic only, never a primary endpoint. The 2026-09-18 audit measured why: zero-shot-binders.csv holds 422 unique HCDR3s of length 11-15 (201 of length 13) of which only 4 meet the SR + 10-mer + Y core constraints; this is an upper bound on full compatibility because that file has no HCDR1/HCDR2 columns; spr-controls.csv holds 1,855 rows / 1,829 unique HCDR3s (758 true, 1,097 false) of which 38 match the fixed H1/H2 plus the Buzz length and anchors, and 1 of those overlaps Buzz training. Cropping an 11-15mer design down to a 10-mer core would not make it the same task, and this repository does not do it. A binders-only file has no negative examples: AUROC is undefined and average precision is 1 for any complete ranking, so it cannot establish binding discrimination. The 37 non-overlapping in-support control rows are retained only in the compatibility audit; no classifier benchmark or performance estimate is derived from them.
